map.📚 深度解析：五子棋禁手判断: 📚 Deep dive: Gomoku Forbidden Move Check
map.三三禁手：一子落下同时形成两个活三（两端可延伸成四），判禁手。: Double-three forbidden move: one move that forms two open threes at once (each can be extended to a four) is a forbidden move.
map.四四禁手：一子同时形成两个冲四/活四，判禁手。: Double-four forbidden move: one move that forms two closed fours / open fours at once is a forbidden move.
map.长连禁手：黑棋连成六子及以上（非恰好五连），判禁手负。: Overline forbidden move: black making six in a row or more (not exactly five) is a forbidden move and loses.
map.落子同时产生两个活三演练: A move that forms two open threes at once worked example
map.输入某落子使横、斜各形成一个活三，工具判定为三三禁手并标注两处活三位置，提示黑棋: Entering a position where a move forms an open three both horizontally and diagonally, the tool judges it a double-three forbidden move and marks the two open-three positions, and notes that black must not play there (white has no forbidden moves).
map.禁手只限黑棋吗？: Are forbidden moves limited to black?
map.是。黑棋先手有禁手以平衡优势；白棋无禁手，长连（≥6）对白棋算胜。: Yes. Black, moving first, has forbidden moves to balance the advantage; white has none, and an overline (6 or more) counts as a win for white.
map.长连对黑棋算胜吗？: Does an overline count as a win for black?
map.不算。黑棋长连（六子及以上）判禁手负；白棋长连判胜。: No. A black overline (six or more) is a forbidden move and loses; a white overline is a win.
map.落子后同时形成两个「活三」（两端均可延伸成四）才构成；若其一为眠三则不判。: It requires two open threes (each can be extended to a four) formed at once after the move; if one of them is a sleeping three, it is not judged as a forbidden move.
